title: Remote authorization and registration
rule: Pin a released MCP revision and exact SDK in the implementation receipt. OAuth 2.1 uses S256 PKCE, exact registered redirect URIs, resource indicators, exact token audience and one deck-access scope. Client ID metadata must be HTTPS with a validated redirect allowlist. Store only token hashes. Access expires after 15 minutes; refresh rotates per connection, reuse revokes the family, revocation is immediate and 30 days idle expires the connection. Consent binds the P01 signed approval intent to the authorization request; no external return URL comes from a payload.
alternatives: Leave this decision deferred and block dependent implementation.
